interpretation.pin_rotation: Passive floating clevis pin; free to rotate in both parent journals and the child journals.
interpretation.body_assignment: The existing parent body is a neutral placement and centreline-motion reference, not a rotational attachment or a solved pin friction model.
interpretation.drive_assumption: Actuation torque is applied to the child link or its pulley, not transmitted through a keyed hinge pin.
interpretation.axial_retention: Original head, groove, washers and nominal clip remain; their fit, spring installation, strength and pull-out retention are unapproved.
interpretation.clip_rotation: Clip rotation envelope and elastic installation require separate checks; its original display orientation is not a rotational constraint.
interpretation.dynamics: Pin spin, friction distribution, fretting and endplay dynamics are not modelled. Parent-body mass assignment is a geometric bookkeeping convention.
interpretation.range: The declared -20..85 degree thumb IP domain is exploratory; it does not establish tested physical travel or a hard stop. The requested pose is -15 degrees.
